title: Grid Routes
statement_md: Walk from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell of a grid, moving only **right** or **down**, never stepping on a blocked cell `#`. Count the routes modulo $1\,000\,000\,007$.
input_md: The first line holds $r$ and $c$. Each of the next $r$ lines holds $c$ characters, `.` for open and `#` for blocked.
output_md: Print the number of routes modulo $10^9 + 7$ (0 if the start or the end is blocked).
hints: Routes into a cell = routes into the cell above + routes into the cell to the left, unless it is blocked.
